headlines.title: Forget McDonald’s kiosks, Whataburger closes high-tech locations
headlines.summary: The restaurant chain closed its first all-digital location experiment after a three-year test period.

headlines.title: McDonald's plans major store changes to attract more customers
headlines.summary: McDonald’s Chairman and CEO says the chain will lean on its scale and loyal customers to pull off a costly new plan for thousands of stores.

headlines.title: McDonald’s (MCD) Trades at 18 Times Earnings. Is the $8.5B Fix Priced In?
headlines.summary: McDonald’s (NYSE:MCD) handed investors a turnaround plan last month, and investors handed back a lower share price. At its investor day in Chicago, the company committed roughly $8.5 billion in support for its franchisees through 2036.

headlines.title: Can MCD's Marketing Reset Help Improve Customer Engagement and Sales?
headlines.summary: Can McDonald's sharper focus on personalized digital offers, value meals and streamlined campaigns help rebuild customer engagement and drive sales growth?

headlines.title: 3 Safe-and-Steady Stocks with Exciting Potential
headlines.summary: Stocks with low volatility can be a great foundation for a portfolio, especially for investors looking to reduce risk. While they don’t often make headlines, these companies provide consistency in an unpredictable market.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
